Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

fīnis

fīnis, fīnis m.

noun, third declension

end; limit; a boundary, a limit; (plural) territory; the end a thing serves, its purpose; the end aimed at, a goal

In this lexicon

  • end

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 1.5.104: Brundisium longae fīnis chartaeque viaeque est; Gell. 7.13.3: edundī fīnis

  • limit

    also used · classical · Hor. S. 1.1.106: sunt certī dēnique fīnēs

  • purpose

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.138: domum … cujus fīnis est ūsus; Quint. 2.17.22: omnēs artēs habēre fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

  • target

    also used · classical · Quint. 2.17.22: fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

  • fīnis hebdomadis: weekend

    modern

Examples

  • Brundisium longae fīnis chartaeque viaeque est

    Brundisium is the end of a long story and a long roadHor. S. 1.5.104

    In the entry for end

  • erātque initium loquendī edundī fīnis

    and the end of eating was the start of talkingGell. 7.13.3

    In the entry for end
